items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: I'm going to ask again about your brother John... that band that he played with the Bichets... John was playing guitar... John was assistant manager of the band.

ctx.x: I'm going to ask again about your brother John we were talking about, that band that he played with the Bichets, and that was about 1916. You say Sydney wasn't very old and it just started out then with...
He was young. It just started out. He used to play flute. He started from a flute and somebody bought him old clarinet and he started playing clarinet and John was playing guitar.
Oh he played guitar, he started then on...
